METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': 'As Lord Sterling and Rupert are apprehended by the Crown, Catherine pleads with Alexander for their past love, only to be coldly rejected as he walks toward his chained bride, Juliana.', 'continuity_notes': "Picks up immediately from Episode 43's cliffhanger at the church side exit; Lord Sterling's escape is blocked by the Police Constable, leading into the downfall of the conspirators."}

SCENE sc_001 0-13800 INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - SIDE ENTRANCE – DAY
EP44:E1 0-3200 CAMERA: Low-angle shot framing the towering stone archway as a stern Police Constable steps through the heavy open doors, blocking Lord Sterling's path.
EP44:E2 0-3200 ACTION: The Police Constable strides firmly down the steps and halts right in front of Lord Sterling, holding his ground.
EP44:E3 3200-8600 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of the Police Constable towering over Lord Sterling.
EP44:E4 3300-8200 POLICE CONSTABLE [Authoritative, Stern]: "Lord Henry Sterling, you are under arrest by order of the Crown."
EP44:E5 8600-11400 CAMERA: Close-up on Lord Sterling's trembling, indignant face.
EP44:E6 9100-11200 LORD STERLING [Snarls, Outraged]: "You have no authority!"
EP44:E7 11400-13800 CAMERA: Close-up on the Constable's black-gloved hands holding out a thick, red-ribboned dossier stamped with the Crown's royal wax seal.
EP44:E8 11400-13200 POLICE CONSTABLE [Cold, Definite]: "I have more than enough."
SCENE sc_002 13800-70500 INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
EP44:E9 13800-16400 CAMERA: Wide shot of the ruined nave littered with rubble as royal redcoat guards surround the aisle, forcing Rupert down onto his knees.
EP44:E10 14000-16400 ACTION: A royal redcoat guard firmly forces Rupert down into the stone dust.
EP44:E11 14000-16800 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Frantic, Shouting]: "Get your hands off me! Catherine!"
EP44:E12 16400-19400 CAMERA: Close-up on Rupert struggling fiercely against the white-gloved grip of the guard pinning his shoulder.
EP44:E13 17400-19300 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Desperate, Screaming]: "Do something!"
EP44:E14 19400-22000 CAMERA: Medium close-up on Catherine beneath her bridal veil, looking downward in conflicted silence.
EP44:E15 21800-24400 ACTION: Catherine's satin-gloved hand clenches tightly into a trembling fist against the folds of her ornate gown.
EP44:E16 22000-24400 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine's gloved hand tightening into a fist.
EP44:E17 24400-27800 CAMERA: Wide shot as Catherine gathers her heavy train and steps away from Rupert, walking toward Alexander who stands watching her stoically.
EP44:E18 25200-28000 CATHERINE [Shaken, Tearful]: "Alexander... I thought you had died."
EP44:E19 27800-31200 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine's face, tears glistening in her eyes as grief breaks through her composure.
EP44:E20 28400-31000 CATHERINE [Choked, Weeping]: "Do you know what this did to me?"
EP44:E21 31200-32400 CAMERA: Medium shot on Alexander standing tall in his ducal coat, his gaze utterly detached.
EP44:E22 31200-32400 CATHERINE [O.S.) (Pleading]: "I mourned you."
EP44:E23 32400-34000 CAMERA: Profile close-up of Catherine as a tear slips down her cheek.
EP44:E24 32400-34000 CATHERINE [Vulnerable, Trembling]: "I waited for you."
EP44:E25 34000-35800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine standing in the center of the aisle before the seated congregation.
EP44:E26 34200-38800 CATHERINE [Heartbroken]: "For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea."
EP44:E27 35800-38800 CAMERA: Tracking two-shot over Alexander's shoulder as Catherine approaches him pleadingly.
EP44:E28 38800-41200 CAMERA: Close profile two-shot as Catherine gently reaches her gloved hand up to Alexander's bearded cheek.
EP44:E29 38900-41200 CATHERINE [Whispering, Longing]: "I never stopped loving you."
EP44:E30 41200-42800 ACTION: Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.
EP44:E31 41200-42800 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine's empty gloved hand trembling in the empty space between them.
EP44:E32 42800-46400 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine lowering her hand, stunned and deeply hurt by his rejection.
EP44:E33 44200-46400 CATHERINE [Breathless, Hurt]: "You don't remember?"
EP44:E34 46400-49000 CAMERA: High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in the foreground, with Rupert held under guard in the background.
EP44:E35 46600-48800 CATHERINE [Desperate, Demanding]: "I was supposed to be your Duchess!"
EP44:E36 49000-51000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Catherine and Alexander confronting each other.
EP44:E37 49200-51000 ALEXANDER [Cold, Implacable]: "You were never my Duchess."
EP44:E38 51000-53000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Catherine's tearful face.
EP44:E39 51100-52800 CATHERINE [Sobbing, Pleading]: "But I loved you!"
EP44:E40 53000-55600 CAMERA: Medium close-up on Alexander, his scarred jaw set firm.
EP44:E41 53000-55500 ALEXANDER [Scornful, Biting]: "You loved the Duke you thought you would marry."
EP44:E42 55600-59000 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine, gasping in protest.
EP44:E43 56200-58200 CATHERINE [Defiant, Pained]: "No!"
EP44:E44 59000-62400 CAMERA: Medium shot as Catherine clutches her chest, pouring her heart out.
EP44:E45 59800-62400 CATHERINE [Passionate, Crying]: "I loved you before all this!"
EP44:E46 62400-63800 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander tilting his head slightly, his gaze piercing through her.
EP44:E47 62500-63400 ALEXANDER [Skeptical, Cutting]: "Did you?"
EP44:E48 63800-65000 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine, rendered speechless by his doubt.
EP44:E49 65000-67800 CAMERA: Tilt-up shot starting from heavy iron chains resting on the wooden floor up to the shackled wrists of Juliana dressed in her rustic grey gown.
EP44:E50 67800-69600 CAMERA: Wide shot from behind Catherine as Alexander turns his back on her and walks resolutely down the rubble-strewn aisle toward Juliana standing in chains at the doorway.
EP44:E51 68000-69600 ACTION: Alexander walks away from Catherine toward Juliana, who waits solemnly by the cathedral entrance.
EP44:E52 69600-70100 CAMERA: Medium close-up on Juliana looking down at her chained hands, lifting her gaze gently.
EP44:E53 70100-70500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Catherine's horrified, bewildered expression as she realizes who Alexander chose.
EP44:E54 70100-70400 CATHERINE [Gasping, Incredulous]: "Her?!"
